description: Compares a signal against a threshold voltage and fires gates and triggers for each side of it

params.text: Sets the threshold the input is compared against, -5V to +5V, with 0V at noon
Attenuverts the CV that shifts the threshold, -1 to +1

inputs.text: The signal compared against the threshold
Shifts the threshold, through its own attenuverter

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the input is above the threshold
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input rises above the threshold
10V for as long as the input is below the threshold
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input falls below the threshold
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input crosses the threshold in either direction, the sum of the two trigger outputs
